messages:
Elena Morales: Quick sync — finalizing landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Want 3 headline variants + one benchmark blurb and webinar CTA. Link to doc: https://notion.redwood/landing-copy. Can people drop microcopy + routing notes by EOD? @Raf @Tess
Raf Chen: On it. Drafting headline options now. Thinking: "Production-grade inference, without the ops" / "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost" / "One API. Any deployment."
Tess King: I like the 2nd one. For Dedicated page lead with: "Predictable throughput, reserved capacity for steady scale." Follow with 3 bullets (autoscale, SLAs, isolation).
Ben Ortiz: For Private page: emphasize compliance + network control. Quick blurb: "Deploy in your VPC or on-prem — full control, enterprise SLAs, and KMS integration."
Elena Morales: @Raf can you add a 1-line benchmark blurb (p95 latency + cost per 1k tokens) for hosted? rough placeholders are fine but avoid hard promises.
Raf Chen: Draft benchmark: "Low-latency chat: p95 < 120ms for typical convo flows; optimized configs reduce cost to ~$0.02 / 1k tokens." (placeholder numbers, will validate).
Tess King: CTA variants we should test: "Start for free" / "Request Dedicated pricing" / "Get Private deployment consult". Also suggest adding subtle secondary CTA: "See benchmarks".
growth-bot: :gear: Experiment created — /experiments/landing-copy-2026. Variants: A (product-led), B (benchmark-first), C (security-first). Tracking: utm=tri-mode-copy.
Ben Ortiz: Inbound routing plan: CTAs -> hosted trial signup (self-serve); Dedicated -> sales form (SFDC lead type: Dedicated); Private -> enterprise contact + solutions-eng ticket. I'll open the routing doc and map webhook events.
Elena Morales: Also planning a short webinar: "Serving at scale: latency & cost playbook". Add registration CTA on the landing + one-page benchmark PDF. Target date: 3 weeks out.
Raf Chen: Proposed hero for the tri-mode landing: "One API, three deployment modes — hosted for speed, dedicated for predictability, private for control." Short subhead: "Same SDKs and routes, different guarantees. Ship faster, scale cheaper."
Tess King: Microcopy for social: "New landing: same API across Hosted / Dedicated / Private — pick the deployment that fits your risk & latency profile. Webinar + benchmarks live."
Ben Ortiz: Quick note for routing implementation: example webhook payload for Dedicated form -> /webhooks/sales:
```
{
  "lead_type": "dedicated",
  "utm_source": "website",
  "plan_interest": "dedicated",
  "email": "..."
}
```
Map to SFDC lead owner: sales-dedicated-queue.
Elena Morales: Nice. @Tess can you add A/B test tracking params and the analytics event names? I want funnel mapping for each CTA.
Tess King: Added utm examples to the doc and event names: `landing.cta.click`, `landing.benchmark.view`, `landing.webinar.register`. Will add GA4 + segment props.
Raf Chen: I added copy comments in the doc and a short benchmark appendix. Will swap placeholder numbers after infra validates.
Ben Ortiz: Routing doc (WIP): https://confluence.redwood/inbound-routing — will update with webhook endpoints and SFDC mapping by EOD.
Elena Morales: Perfect. Last ask: make sure Private page avoids overly technical promises; lead with control + compliance, then call out optional managed service. Thanks team. :rocket:
Raf Chen: Comments resolved, pushing a second draft in the doc.
Tess King: A/B test setup ready, test IDs in the doc.
Ben Ortiz: Routing tasks created in JIRA: INF-9123 (hosted), INF-9124 (dedicated), INF-9125 (private).
Elena Morales: That should do it for today. I'll do a final review tomorrow morning. :raised_hands:
